incoming_quantities.name: incoming_quantities
incoming_quantities.value: "incoming_batches"."capacity" >= 0 AND "incoming_batches"."confirmed_allocation" >= "incoming_batches"."capacity" AND "incoming_batches"."requested_quantity" >= "incoming_batches"."confirmed_allocation" AND "incoming_batches"."safety_buffer" BETWEEN 0 AND "incoming_batches"."capacity" AND "incoming_batches"."sellable_quantity" >= 0 AND "incoming_batches"."damaged_quantity" >= 0 AND "incoming_batches"."received_quantity" >= "incoming_batches"."sellable_quantity" + "incoming_batches"."damaged_quantity"

orders_money_nonnegative.name: orders_money_nonnegative
orders_money_nonnegative.value:
"orders"."subtotal_cents" >= 0 AND "orders"."shipping_cents" >= 0 AND
      "orders"."platform_fee_cents" >= 0 AND "orders"."tax_cents" >= 0 AND "orders"."total_cents" >= 0 AND
      "orders"."refunded_amount_cents" >= 0 AND "orders"."refunded_amount_cents" <= "orders"."total_cents" AND
      "orders"."seller_transfer_amount_cents" >= 0 AND "orders"."seller_transfer_reversed_cents" >= 0 AND
      "orders"."seller_transfer_reversed_cents" <= "orders"."seller_transfer_amount_cents"

tax_tasks_amounts_nonnegative.name: tax_tasks_amounts_nonnegative
tax_tasks_amounts_nonnegative.value: ("tax_tasks"."amount_due_cents" IS NULL OR "tax_tasks"."amount_due_cents" >= 0) AND ("tax_tasks"."amount_paid_cents" IS NULL OR "tax_tasks"."amount_paid_cents" >= 0)
